content.value_statement: Influencer teams lose context about rates, contacts, exclusivity, and disclosure history. This skill turns scattered campaign updates into one sourced creator record.
actual_capabilities: Creates or updates canonical creator records from closed campaign outcomes.
Reconciles pending creator updates and records what changed with source details.
Deduplicates cross-platform handles using confirmed evidence instead of similarity alone.
Stores dated rate, exclusivity, contact, compliance, and performance facts with provenance.
Promotes roster-critical reminders to hot-cache and unresolved identity conflicts to open loops.
limitations: Does not score creator fit, judge content compliance, discover new creators, or negotiate contracts.
Requires user-provided records, campaign outputs, or pasted exports to build the registry.
Must confirm a lawful basis before saving personal data about natural persons.
Cannot verify private CRM, platform, or contract data without user-provided evidence.

use_cases.title: Answer roster history questions
use_cases.description: Look up prior rates, response history, contact path, and exclusivity dates for a known creator.

use_cases.title: Reconcile campaign close-out updates
use_cases.description: Merge final rates, deliverables, results, and disclosure events into the creator record after a campaign ends.

use_cases.title: Prepare renewal or contract context
use_cases.description: Surface rate ceilings, usage rights history, and expiring exclusivity windows before outreach or legal review.

prompt_templates.title: Ask a creator history question
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner lookup for one rostered creator.
prompt_templates.prompt: What did we pay @creatorhandle last time, when does exclusivity lapse, and are there open disclosure events?

prompt_templates.title: Update after a closed campaign
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate record update using campaign close-out details.
prompt_templates.prompt: Consolidate the creator record for @creatorhandle. The campaign closed today, and I will provide the final rate, deliverables, performance result, and source notes.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile pending candidate updates
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced roster maintenance across several pending updates.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the pending creator updates, merge only sourced facts into canonical records, log conflicts, and clear processed candidate lines.

prompt_templates.title: Audit identity and compliance history
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced deduplication and provenance review before renewal.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether these creator handles belong to the same person, cite the evidence, preserve unconfirmed links, and summarize dated compliance events without assigning a risk label.

output_examples.input: What did we pay @mika last time and is exclusivity still active?
output_examples.output: A sourced roster answer with the last agreed rate, campaign source, exclusivity category, expiry date, and any open follow-up items.

output_examples.input: Consolidate @sarah_ig after the spring launch campaign closed.
output_examples.output: An updated creator record summary, a change log of merged fields, and a handoff note for outreach or contract review.

output_examples.input: Reconcile three pending updates for the same creator from outreach, contract, and performance notes.
output_examples.output: A conflict-aware merge summary showing accepted facts, rejected duplicates, unresolved identity issues, and processed update status.

best_practices: Require a source and an as-of date for every merged fact.
Keep compliance events as dated entries and cite the originating reviewer verdict when available.
Ask for lawful basis before saving personal data, especially for EU, EEA, or UK creators.
anti_patterns: Do not merge creator identities based only on similar names, handles, or audience overlap.
Do not turn compliance history into a broad compliant or risky label.
Do not use this skill for fit scoring, content review, discovery, or contract drafting.

faq.question: What does this skill store?
faq.answer: It stores sourced creator facts such as handles, rates, contact path, exclusivity, compliance events, and performance baselines.

faq.question: Can it decide if a creator is a good fit?
faq.answer: No. It supplies facts to fit scoring workflows, but it does not score, rank, gate, or judge creators.

faq.question: Does it require external tools?
faq.answer: No. It works from user records, pasted exports, and existing memory files. Optional connectors can refresh data when available.

faq.question: How does it handle privacy?
faq.answer: It prompts for lawful basis before canonical writes and treats creators as natural persons whose personal data needs care.

faq.question: What happens when facts conflict?
faq.answer: Newer dated facts win. Same-date conflicts prefer measured data over user-provided data, then estimated data, with the loser logged.

faq.question: Can it run in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill hosts.
